Frequently Asked Questions

Real Questions from Business Owners

Why did my bill go up 40% when I used less energy?

Short answer: Demand charges are based on your highest 15-minute usage spike, not your total monthly consumption.

If you ran your HVAC, compressor, and forklift charger at the same time for just 15 minutes, that sets your demand charge for the entire month.

What to do: Stagger your equipment startups. Even 10 minutes between heavy loads can cut demand charges by 30-50%.

What's the difference between supply and delivery charges?

Supply is the cost of the electricity itself. Delivery is the cost to move it to your building.

In deregulated states, you can shop for supply separately, but delivery is fixed by your utility.

Can I switch to a cheaper rate plan?

Usually yes. Most businesses are on a "default" rate that their utility assigned years ago. Utilities rarely tell you when better options become available.

Is this tool really free? How do you make money?

Yes, it's free. We make money through affiliate links to energy consultants. We never sell your data. Your bills are processed locally in your browser.
